LanguageData.OARK_ScienceDepartment_GravTechPointsAdd: Oberonia Aurea Orchid anti-gravity tech reverse-engineering progress +{0}
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_GravTechStageUpgrade: With your assistance, the research department achieved breakthrough progress in reverse-engineering anti-gravity technology, now reaching stage {0}.\n\nIn recognition of your efforts, they've allocated an additional {1} research contribution.
LanguageData.OARK_AccessScienceDepartmentInfo_Empty:
This is a Oberonia Aurea Orchid court department we haven't established contact with. They're not as comprehensive as the Court Department, nor as prominent as the Industry Department, nor as active as the Technical Department. We know little about them.

They appear focused on developing new technologies.

Currently we have no interaction with the Science Department.
Perhaps we need to do something to get their attention.
LanguageData.OARK_ScienceDepartmentProgress_Assist: {0} took the call from the research officer, greeting you and sharing recent observations.
LanguageData.OARK_QuestDonateGravlitePanel: Gift reverse version auxiliary research to {0}
LanguageData.OARK_QuestDonateGravlitePanelConfirm: I have given {0} the {1} reverse version as a gift, which has improved the progress of the research department's reverse engineering by {2} and provided you with {3} scientific research contributions
LanguageData.OARK_AcquireDataBeaconConfirm: You may request a research beacon. When active, strong dataflows will trigger mechanoid attacks during launches/landings, while providing valuable real-time data.\n\nAs this assists research, it costs nothing. However, beacon complexity means replacements take significant time after destruction.
LanguageData.OARK_DonateGravcoreConfirm: Your donated core advanced research by {0} points.\n\nIn gratitude, the director allocated {1} research contribution and personally thanked you.
LanguageData.OARK_DonateGravlitePanelInfo: Donate specified quantities of anti-gravity panels to advance research and earn contributions.
LanguageData.OARK_DonateGravlitePanelDetailConfirm: Your {0} panel donation advanced research by {1} points.\n\nThe research officer allocated {2} contribution in thanks.
LanguageData.OARK_SailorAssistanceConfirm: Temporarily request a navigation attendant for 30-day assistance, convertible to permanent via contribution.\n\nCost: {0} research contribution
LanguageData.OARK_ExchangeForSDAssistanceConfirm: The research department has delivered a communication device. You can use this to contact them and obtain extensive research data to accelerate your project.\n\nCost: {1} research contribution points.
LanguageData.OARK_GravityDistortionBombConfirmInfo: WARNING: Gravity distortion will cause map-wide damage to all units. Exposure without roof cover will cause severe gravitational tearing damage. Even roofs only provide partial protection. The only safe location is inside cryptosleep caskets.\n\nConfirm deployment?
LanguageData.OARK_GravityDistortionBombConfirm: Gravity distortion bombardment deployed. Arrival in 5 seconds.\n\nWARNING: Enter cryptosleep immediately or seek overhead cover.
LanguageData.OARK_CovertGTAPInfo: Convert research contributions into needed resources - support points, silver, blueprints, or specialized equipment.
LanguageData.OARK_CovertGTAPToAPInfo: Exchange research contributions for imperial support points at fixed rates, gaining broader imperial support beyond just research assistance.
LanguageData.OARK_CovertGTAPToSliverInfo: Exchange research contributions for silver at fixed rates for general use.
LanguageData.OARK_ExchangeForTechPrintInfo: Redeem research contributions for Oberonia Aurea Orchid Empire blueprints. The department's open policies impose no normal restrictions on blueprint acquisition.
LanguageData.OARK_ExchangeForSpecialEquipmentInfo: Exchange research contributions for specialized equipment surplus from research departments. Abundant stock and low imperial demand ensures unlimited availability.
